senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. עְשַׁן) [thick, cmp. עָב, אָבָק &c.,] smoke, soot.
units: <cite ref="Keritot 6a:45">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>מעלה ע׳</he> smoke-raiser (name of a plant).
<cite ref="Yoma 21b:4">Yoma 21ᵇ</cite> <he>עֲשַׁן המערכה</he> the smoke rising from the pyre in the Temple; <cite ref="Bava Batra 147a">B. Bath. 147ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲשַׁנִּים</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 23a:5">Sabb. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>כל הע׳ יפין וכ׳</he> all soots are good for making ink, but that produced by burning olive oil is the best.
